question: In *∆ *ABC*,* ∠A = 88°. If I is the incentre of the triangle, then the measure of ∠BIC* *is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

We know incentre is a meet point of all the angle bisectors

So, ∠BIC = 90° + ∠A/2

⇒ ∠BIC = 90° + 88°/2

⇒ ∠BIC = 90° + 44°

⇒ ∠BIC = 134°

∴ The measure of ∠BIC* *is 134°</
